standard_prerequisites.name: The complement of an effective Cartier divisor is affine, applied to the exceptional divisor of the blowing up
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 879-886) as cross-chapter pointers to the chapter on divisors
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the inclusion of the complement of the exceptional divisor affine, so that its higher direct images vanish.

standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing of the higher direct images of a morphism above the dimension of its fibres, and the Leray spectral sequence
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 891-898) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Combine the two vanishing statements into the vanishing of the cohomology of the complement above d, which is the definition of the required bound.

core_obligations: Open the picture: the proof introduces the inclusion of the complement of the zero locus of the ideal into the blowing up, and observes that the exceptional divisor being an effective Cartier divisor makes this inclusion affine (proof lines 879-886)
First vanishing: for a quasi-coherent module on the complement the higher direct images under the affine inclusion vanish (proof lines 887-890)
Second vanishing: the higher direct images under the blowing up morphism of the pushed forward module vanish from degree d on, by the fibre dimension hypothesis (proof lines 891-893)

Assemble by Leray: the Leray spectral sequence for the composite gives the vanishing of the higher direct images of the composite above d, hence the vanishing of the cohomology of the complement, which is precisely the bound on the cohomological dimension (proof lines 894-899)
proof_roadmap: 令 U = X ∖ V(I)，j : U → X' 为到爆破中的开浸入。例外除子是有效 Cartier 除子，故 j 是仿射的；于是对 U 上的拟凝聚层 F 有 R^p j_*F = 0 (p > 0)。
又由纤维维数 ≤ d-1，R^q b_*(j_*F) = 0 (q ≥ d)；用 Leray 谱序列得 R^n(b∘j)_*F = 0 (n ≥ d)，即 H^n(U,F) = 0 (n ≥ d)，按定义即 cd(A,I) ≤ d。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement bounds the cohomological dimension of an ideal by d whenever the blowing up of the ideal has fibres of dimension at most d - 1 (author lemma at source lines 870-876, label lemma-cd-blowup). The proof (source lines 878-900) is an application of the Leray spectral sequence: the inclusion of the complement of the zero locus into the blowing up is affine because the exceptional divisor is an effective Cartier divisor, the higher direct images of the blowing up itself vanish above the fibre dimension, and the two vanishing statements combine to the vanishing of the cohomology of the complement from degree d on (proof lines 891-899). The composition of the two vanishing statements through Leray is the content. H2.
